'''Skeletons''' are [[undead]] [[monster]]s found in various locations across [[Gielinor]], often in graveyards and [[dungeon]]s. Being an undead monster, they are susceptible to [[Crumble Undead]] and the [[Salve amulet]]. They are also often weak against [[crush]] attacks.

==Trivia==
*The level 45 skeletons in the [[Crandor and Karamja Dungeon]], just outside of [[Elvarg]]'s lair, seem taller than the other skeletons and appear to be the same size as [[giant skeleton]]s.
*Upon opening a wardrobe, there is a 1/21 chance of a non-interactable skeleton appearing inside.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/995762966518788096|date=13 May 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99840|archivedate=28 May 2020}} This is a reference to {{wp|Skeleton in the closet (idiom)|a common idiom}}. If there is a skeleton inside the wardrobe, searching the wardrobe yields the text "''Eek! There's a skeleton in there.''"
*There are level 35 skeletons in the [[Wrath Altar]] - they cannot be attacked, and examining them gives the text "Even in death he still fights." While they have swords, they use the same attack animation as [[zombie]]s.
